qa: App Fusion is possible with the following combinations. ●[Musimon] with [Recomon] link card ●[Musimon] with [Mcmon] link card ●[Recomon] with [Musimon] link card ●[Recomon] with [Mcmon] link card ●[Mcmon] with [Musimon] link card ●[Mcmon] with [Recomon] link card
extracted.special_digivolution_condition: [App Fusion] [Musimon] & [Recomon] & [Mcmon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [App Fusion] [Musimon] & [Recomon] & [Mcmon]: Cost 0 If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked, you may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your hand without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Link Condition
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.)

text_sections.label: Link Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
